goal: Replace pi-context’s parallel runtime ledger with an on-demand bounded snapshot built from Pi native context and session APIs.

tasks.title: Characterize operator-visible context outcomes
acceptance: Tests characterize remaining-context, contributor, pressure, deduplication, hysteresis, and export outcomes
Tests identify forensic features that can be removed

approachReasons.tdd: Characterization tests must lock down retained visible behavior.
approachReasons.diagnosis: Existing ledger outputs and event dependencies must be measured before removal.
approachReasons.security: Characterization must identify content that could expose sensitive context.

tasks.title: Design the bounded native snapshot
acceptance: Design uses ctx.getContextUsage(), getSystemPromptOptions(), and active branch data
Snapshot has explicit resource bounds and excludes sensitive content
Streaming-update and per-tool execution ledgers are excluded

approachReasons.security: Snapshot fields must prevent sensitive content disclosure.
approachReasons.performance: The snapshot must be bounded and on-demand.

tasks.title: Implement usage and contributor reporting
acceptance: Reports remaining context and broad contributors from native APIs
Contributor reporting is aggregate and content-safe
Every collection dimension, content-block traversal, and measured string has a hard cap; truncation is reported

approachReasons.tdd: Usage calculations, contributor grouping, and truncation boundaries require regression tests.
approachReasons.security: Contributor output must not disclose prompt, session content, paths, identifiers, or exception text.
approachReasons.performance: Native snapshot computation must cap collection lengths, nested content blocks, and measured string characters.

evidence.command: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/pi-context-native-snapshot.test.ts test/pi-context-native-snapshot-contract.test.ts test/pi-context-characterization.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.title: Implement pressure thresholds and explicit export
acceptance: Pressure notifications retain hysteresis and deduplication
Markdown and JSON export occur only on explicit request

approachReasons.tdd: Threshold transitions and deduplication are stateful boundary cases.
approachReasons.security: Explicit exports must enforce content-safe schemas.

tasks.title: Replace the event-heavy ledger
acceptance: No streaming-update or per-tool execution ledger remains
Unjustified forensic features are explicitly removed

approachReasons.migration: The parallel ledger must be retired without leaving duplicate runtime paths.
approachReasons.performance: Reduced subscriptions and retained state are core resource goals.

evidence.command: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-reporter=dot test/**/*.test.ts && npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm run check:performance

tasks.title: Qualify HUD compatibility and resource bounds
acceptance: Snapshot remains bounded and content-safe under oversized and adversarial inputs
Pressure behavior and explicit exports pass integration tests

approachReasons.tdd: Final compatibility and behavior require automated verification.
approachReasons.security: Qualification must confirm no sensitive content is exposed for hostile input shapes.
approachReasons.performance: Resource caps and reduced subscriptions must be measured, including per-value bounds.

args: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/pi-context*.test.ts test/pi-hud*.test.ts && npm run typecheck
